arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math
import statistics

# National Defense expenditures (in millions)
expenditures = {
    1933: 680,
    1934: 531,
    1935: 689,
    1936: 900,
    1937: 929,
    1938: 1029,
    1939: 1206,
    1940: 1657,
    1941: 6301
}

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates
years = sorted(expenditures.keys())
log_growth_rates = []

for i in range(1, len(years)):
    prev_year = years[i-1]
    curr_year = years[i]
    growth_rate = math.log(expenditures[curr_year] / expenditures[prev_year])
    log_growth_rates.append(growth_rate)
    print(f"{prev_year}-{curr_year}: ln({expenditures[curr_year]}/{expenditures[prev_year]}) = ln({expenditures[curr_year]/expenditures[prev_year]:.6f}) = {growth_rate:.6f}")

print(f"\nLog growth rates: {log_growth_rates}")
print(f"Number of log growth rates: {len(log_growth_rates)}")

# Calculate population standard deviation
mean = sum(log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
print(f"\nMean of log growth rates: {mean:.6f}")

# Population variance (divide by N, not N-1)
variance = sum((x - mean) ** 2 for x in log_growth_rates) / len(log_growth_rates)
pop_std = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f"Population standard deviation: {pop_std:.6f}")

# Coefficient of variation = std / mean
cv = pop_std / mean
print(f"\nCoefficient of variation: {cv:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to nearest hundredth: {round(cv, 2)}")
EOF
